어머니.forms: 어머니가 · 어머니를 · honorific: 어머님 · casual: 엄마
어머니.e: Casual form 엄마 (mom); 할머니 (grandmother) is built on it.

만.forms: Sino-Korean · money, large numbers (만 원, 십만, 백만)
만.t: Korean groups big numbers by 10,000: 100,000 = 십만, 1,000,000 = 백만.

만.forms: same after consonant or vowel: 물만, 하나만 · 만 can replace 이/가, 을/를
만.e: 물만 주세요 = Just water, please. Different from 만 (ten thousand).

화요일.x: I have Korean class on Tuesday.
화요일.e: 'Fire day' — named for Mars, the fire planet.

사무실.x: The office is on the third floor.
사무실.t: 사무실 is the physical room; 회사 is the company itself.

돌.x: There's a big rock on the road. Be careful.
돌.t: 돌 also means a baby's first birthday (돌잔치 = first-birthday party).

베란다.x: My mom grows flowers on the balcony.
베란다.e: From English 'veranda'; in Korean apartments it is usually an enclosed, glassed-in balcony.

식탁.x: Mom set out the side dishes on the dining table.

바라다.m: to hope, to wish, to want
바라다.x: I hope all of you stay healthy in the new year.
바라다.e: The noun 바람 'wish' comes from 바라- + -ㅁ.
바라다.t: Standard form is 바라요, though many people say 바래요 in speech.

빠지다.m: to fall into; to fall out, to come out; to be left out, to skip; to be into
빠지다.ex: 요즘 한국 드라마에 빠져서 매일 봐요.
빠지다.x: I'm really into Korean dramas lately, so I watch them every day.
빠지다.e: Core idea is 'slip out or sink in': 머리가 빠지다, 물에 빠지다.
빠지다.t: Common chunks: 살이 빠지다 (lose weight), 수업에 빠지다 (skip class), 사랑에 빠지다 (fall in love).

변호사.ex: 우리 언니는 서울에서 변호사로 일하고 있어요.
변호사.x: My older sister works as a lawyer in Seoul.

줄무늬.ex: 오늘 줄무늬 티셔츠를 입고 학교에 갔어요.
줄무늬.x: I wore a striped T-shirt to school today.
줄무늬.t: Pronounced [줄무니] — ㅢ after a consonant sounds like ㅣ.

온라인.ex: 요즘은 온라인으로 수업을 듣는 학생이 많아요.
온라인.x: These days many students take classes online.
온라인.e: From English 'online'; pronounced [올라인] because ㄴ before ㄹ becomes ㄹ.

보름달.ex: 추석 밤에 보름달을 보면서 소원을 빌었어요.
보름달.x: On Chuseok night, I made a wish while looking at the full moon.
보름달.e: 보름 'the 15th day of the lunar month' + 달 'moon'.
보름달.t: Pronounced [보름딸]. Making a wish on the full moon is a Chuseok and 정월 대보름 tradition.

직책.ex: 그는 새로운 직책을 맡아서 요즘 무척 바빠요.
직책.x: He took on a new role, so he's very busy these days.

브랜드.x: This bag is a famous brand-name product.
브랜드.e: From English 'brand'; 명품 브랜드 means a luxury brand.

폭등.ex: 집값 폭등으로 젊은 사람들이 집을 사기 어려워요.
폭등.x: Because housing prices skyrocketed, it's hard for young people to buy homes.

성형.m: cosmetic surgery, plastic surgery; molding, shaping
성형.x: These days, a lot of men get cosmetic surgery too.

우주선.ex: 우주선이 여섯 달 만에 무사히 지구로 돌아왔습니다.
우주선.x: The spacecraft returned safely to Earth after six months.

도시화.x: The rural population has dropped a lot due to urbanization.

감격스럽다.ex: 10년 만에 가족을 다시 만나서 정말 감격스러웠어요.
감격스럽다.x: It was truly overwhelming to see my family again after ten years.
감격스럽다.e: 감격 + -스럽다 'full of': full of stirred-up feelings.

베풀다.forms: 베풀어요 · 베풀었어요 · 베풀 거예요 · 베푸세요 (ㄹ drops)
베풀다.m: to give, to bestow, to show (kindness); to throw (a party)
베풀다.ex: 그분은 어려운 이웃에게 항상 사랑을 베풀어요.
베풀다.x: That person always shows love to neighbors in need.
베풀다.t: Takes abstract objects like 친절, 은혜, 사랑, or 잔치 (to throw a feast).

자기중심적.x: It's hard to work with self-centered people.

겨루다.m: to compete, to contend, to match skills
겨루다.x: The two teams went head to head in the final.
겨루다.t: Common pattern: 실력을 겨루다 'to test skills against each other'.

누리다.m: to enjoy (a benefit, freedom, a good life)
누리다.ex: 할아버지는 은퇴 후에 여유로운 생활을 누리고 계세요.
누리다.x: My grandfather is enjoying a relaxed life after retiring.
누리다.t: Use 누리다 for privileges or rights like 자유 and 혜택; for food or fun, use 즐기다.

마음에 걸리다.m: to weigh on one's mind, to bother someone
마음에 걸리다.ex: 친구에게 화를 낸 것이 계속 마음에 걸려요.
마음에 걸리다.x: Getting angry at my friend keeps weighing on my mind.
마음에 걸리다.e: Literally 'to get caught on the heart,' like something snagging.
마음에 걸리다.t: Don't mix it up with 마음에 들다 'to like': 마음에 걸리다 means something bothers you.

오티티.ex: 요즘은 영화를 극장보다 오티티로 더 많이 봐요.
오티티.x: These days I watch movies on streaming services more than at the theater.
오티티.e: The English letters OTT ('over-the-top') read in Korean.
오티티.t: Usually written OTT. 구독하다 = to subscribe to a service.

어쩐지.forms: 어쩐지 + reason: 어쩐지 …더라고요 · 어쩐지 기분이 이상해요 (somehow)
어쩐지.x: Was today a holiday? No wonder the streets were so quiet.
어쩐지.e: From 어찌하다 'how' + -ㄴ지 'whether': 'I didn't know how, but …'.
어쩐지.t: Two uses: after you learn the reason, 어쩐지! means 'No wonder!'; for an unexplained feeling it means 'somehow', like 왠지.

피의자.x: The police called in the suspect for questioning.
피의자.t: A 피의자 becomes a 피고인 once formally indicted.

망상.ex: 그는 누군가 자신을 감시한다는 망상에 빠졌어요.
망상.x: He fell into the delusion that someone was watching him.

유의미하다.x: We obtained significant results in this experiment.
유의미하다.e: Literally 'having meaning'. 유- = having: 유명하다, 유용하다.
유의미하다.t: In research, 통계적으로 유의미한 차이 = 'statistically significant difference'.

문제시하다.m: to regard as a problem, to call into question
문제시하다.ex: 전문가들은 그 정책의 효과를 문제시하고 있어요.
문제시하다.x: Experts are calling the policy's effectiveness into question.

돌파구.ex: 두 나라는 협상에서 돌파구를 찾지 못했어요.
돌파구.x: The two countries failed to find a breakthrough in the negotiations.
돌파구.e: Literally 'rush-break opening' — a gap smashed through a wall.

혁명.ex: 스마트폰은 우리 생활에 큰 혁명을 가져왔어요.
혁명.x: Smartphones brought a huge revolution to our daily lives.
혁명.e: Literally 'changing the mandate', i.e. replacing those in power.
혁명.t: Pronounced [형명] — ㄱ becomes ㅇ before ㅁ (nasalization).

적대국.ex: 두 나라는 과거에 적대국이었지만 지금은 협력하고 있어요.
적대국.x: The two countries were once enemies, but now they cooperate.
적대국.e: Literally 'country facing you as an enemy'.

영양실조.ex: 전쟁 지역의 많은 아이들이 영양실조에 시달리고 있습니다.
영양실조.x: Many children in war zones are suffering from malnutrition.
영양실조.t: Common pattern: 영양실조에 걸리다 or 영양실조에 시달리다 (to suffer from malnutrition).

꼬투리.m: pod (of beans); something to nitpick, a flaw to pick on
꼬투리.x: My boss picks on even the smallest mistakes.
꼬투리.e: Literally a bean pod; figuratively a small loose end someone grabs to start trouble.
꼬투리.t: Almost always 꼬투리를 잡다, 'to nitpick, catch someone on a small detail.'

감사보고서.ex: 감사보고서에 따르면 회사의 부채가 크게 늘었습니다.
감사보고서.x: According to the audit report, the company's debt rose sharply.

국정조사.ex: 야당은 그 사건에 대한 국정조사를 요구했습니다.
국정조사.x: The opposition demanded a parliamentary investigation into the incident.
국정조사.t: 국정감사 is a regular yearly review; 국정조사 targets one specific scandal when needed.

이데올로기.x: During the Cold War, ideological confrontation was intense.
이데올로기.e: From German 'Ideologie' — hence the -기 ending instead of English '-gy'.
이데올로기.t: The Sino-Korean word 이념 means the same and is more common in news headlines.

법당.ex: 법당에 들어갈 때는 신발을 벗어야 해요.
법당.x: You have to take off your shoes when you enter the temple hall.
법당.e: Literally 'dharma hall': where the Buddha's teaching is given.

극락.ex: 할머니는 돌아가신 할아버지가 극락에 가셨다고 믿으세요.
극락.x: Grandma believes our late grandfather went to paradise.
극락.e: Literally 'utmost joy' — the Buddhist land of perfect happiness.
극락.t: Pronounced [긍낙] — nasalization; 극락 is Buddhist, while Christians say 천국.

성정.ex: 그는 성정이 온화해서 화를 잘 내지 않아요.
성정.x: He has a gentle nature, so he rarely gets angry.

이환율.m: morbidity rate, rate of falling ill
이환율.ex: 겨울철에는 어린이들의 독감 이환율이 크게 높아집니다.
이환율.x: In winter, the rate of children catching the flu rises sharply.
이환율.e: Literally 'rate of being struck by illness.'

붕당.x: The factions were divided according to their scholarly positions.
붕당.e: Literally 'party of friends', groups bound by teacher and school.

여리박빙.m: walking on thin ice, acting with extreme caution
여리박빙.x: He ran the company as though walking on thin ice.
여리박빙.t: Note 박빙 alone means 'neck and neck': 박빙의 승부 'a razor-thin contest'.

하릴없이.m: helplessly, with no other choice; unmistakably
하릴없이.ex: 버스를 놓친 우리는 하릴없이 걸어서 집에 갔어요.
하릴없이.x: Having missed the bus, we had no choice but to walk home.
하릴없이.e: From 하릴없다 'to have no way out'; not the same as 할 일 없이 'with nothing to do'.
하릴없이.t: Pronounced [하리럽씨]; many people misuse it as 'idly', but the dictionary sense is 'helplessly'.

과로사.ex: 택배 기사의 과로사가 사회 문제가 되었습니다.
과로사.x: Delivery drivers dying from overwork has become a social issue.

내재화.x: Children naturally internalize their parents' values.

망운지정.ex: 타국에서 일하는 그는 늘 망운지정에 잠기곤 했어요.
망운지정.x: Working abroad, he was often lost in longing for his parents.
망운지정.e: Literally 'the feeling of gazing at clouds' toward where one's parents live.

측두엽.ex: 측두엽은 소리를 듣고 이해하는 데 관여합니다.
측두엽.x: The temporal lobe is involved in hearing and understanding sounds.
측두엽.e: Literally 'side head lobe': it sits by the temples.
측두엽.t: Pronounced [측뚜엽]: ㄷ after ㄱ becomes tense.
